description.value: Shinobi Sushi is a Japanese restaurant group with two Maple Ridge locations — a downtown sit-down spot on 224 St and a smaller express outlet on 240 St. The menu is sushi-focused and the business supports online ordering with local delivery. It sits in a suburban commercial area of Maple Ridge convenient to the Haney Bypass cycling corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at shinobisushi.com is live and shows two active Maple Ridge locations under the brand 'Shinobi Sushi', confirming the business is open. The OSM name 'Shinobi Japanese Restaurant' does not match the website name 'Shinobi Sushi', and neither an address nor phone number is present in OSM tags, so the correct location cannot be confirmed from OSM alone. The website prominently features online ordering and delivery, confirming takeout; no cyclist-specific amenity information (bike parking, water, Wi-Fi, washrooms) is mentioned anywhere.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Shinobi Japanese Restaurant' but the website brand is 'Shinobi Sushi'.
Website shows two distinct locations (Shinobi Downtown at 11867 224 St and Shinobi Express at 150-11939 240 St); OSM node has no address and it is unclear which location this record corresponds to.
No address or phone number present in OSM tags, preventing contact confirmation.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Japanese restaurant in Maple Ridge with an active website and online ordering — a useful stop for touring cyclists in the area.
